references.text: In Judges, the virgins from Jabesh-Gilead are spared in a similar way; those who had not slept with a man were kept alive.
Moses gives instructions on warfare, where women and children may be taken as plunder when a city is conquered.
Rules for taking a woman as a wife among war captives, showing the treatment of women taken in war.
The preceding verse explains that all who had slept with a man were to be killed, providing context for who was spared.
The summary of the plunder shows that 32,000 virgins were spared—those who had not known a man.
Valuation of persons by age and gender in connection with vows to the Lord, showing how women and children were valued.
